messages:
incident-bot: :zap: urgent: elevated 429s from /v1/chat in eu-west-1. Alert: quota-enforcer.high_rejection_rate > 75% for last 5m. Paging on-call.

samir: i'm on pager. pulling up dashboards now. initial spike started at ~1952118200.

elyse: can confirm: token_ledger shows a sudden reconciliation delta where expected_tokens != recorded_tokens for many org keys. looks like a matching change in the new canary.

tom_b: canary rl-service v2 promoted to 15% at 1952118000. Changes: exemption matching refactor + faster path for cache miss. Could be a regression in exemption predicate.

linda_ops: CS reports 6 customers in EU seeing request failures. one is paying enterprise customer reporting errors from their QA environment. CS wants ETA.

samir: quick mitigation options: 1) kill-switch flag to disable new exemption matcher 2) route traffic away from canary 3) increase quota windows temporarily. Which do we try first?

elyse: flip flag and pause pipeline. The flag is `flag:rl/exemption_refactor`. I can flip.

deploy-bot: Action requested by elyse: toggle flag rl/exemption_refactor -> false. Validating access... OK. Applying change... SUCCESS at 1952118955.

infra-bot: Noted config change. Propagating to rate-limiter nodes (approx 45s).

tom_b: pausing canary promote job in CI: `cictl pause rl-service/canary`

deploy-bot: Pipeline paused.

samir: after flag flip, 429 rate dropped by ~60% in 2m. Still seeing residual rejects for some org keys.

elyse: pulling a sample from logs:
```
quota-enforcer: req=7f9d path=/v1/chat key=org:acme tokens_allowed=0 expected_quota=200 match_rule=prefix:/acme/ reason=match-failed(ignored-trailing-slash)
```

cs_anna: filed an immediate customer notify template. sending: "We're investigating elevated rate limits affecting some API keys in EU. We've applied a kill-switch and paused the rollout. We'll follow up with a timeline and root cause."

linda_ops: customers want assurance about data loss and retries. any evidence of lost tokens or double-billing?

elyse: no evidence of double-billing; token_accounting shows tokens were not consumed (requests blocked pre-consumption). ledger has inconsistent state due to a cast/truncation bug when the exemption matcher returned empty metadata; adding this to postmortem.

samir: plan: 1) keep flag off 2) hold rollout pipeline 3) restart rate-limiter pods to pick new config 4) run backfill to reconcile ledgers if needed 5) CS to schedule customer callbacks. assigning owners: elyse flips/monitor, tom handles rollback/pipeline, samir does reconciliation, linda_ops coordinates CS.

infra-bot: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/quota-enforcer -n prod` started at 1952119060.

deploy-bot: rolling back canary to stable v1.9.1 as safety: rollback initiated at 1952119102, completed at 1952119205.

samir: monitoring metrics: rejection rates down to baseline within 4m of rollback. Good.

elyse: creating hotfix branch to fix trailing-slash predicate and add unit tests and integration smoke test that runs exemption checks during canary gate. Opening PR now.

tom_b: adding an automated canary gate step: run a small exemption-smoke job validating a set of tenant keys against both matcher versions before promoting. Will draft RFC for gating.

cs_anna: CS notes: impacted customers list attached to internal ticket INC-1952118888-CS. We'll start outreach and offer credits if required.

linda_ops: handing off to elyse for next 45m while I update execs. summary in channel please.

elyse: ack. summary: regression from exemption refactor in rl-service v2 caused prefix/exact mismatch + a ledger edge-case -> some orgs returned match-failed and were over-throttled. Mitigation: kill-switch flipped, canary rolled back, pods restarted. Actions: postmortem, hotfix PR, canary smoke gating, customer outreach.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. closed_by=elyse at 1952119400.

samir: followups: reconcile any tokens that were incorrectly marked; verify billing logs; add an alert for exemption-hit-rate-drop so we catch this earlier.

cs_anna: will coordinate customer updates and send a joint timeline once postmortem is ready.

elyse: thanks all. leaving channel open for postmortem comments and timeline capture. :white_check_mark:
